item.title: Israel’s Arrest of Journalist Abed Abu Shehadeh Raises Concerns
item.description: Abed Abu Shehadeh, a Palestinian citizen of Israel, was detained without being charged with a crime, raising concerns that the domestic security service is overstepping its authority.

item.title: Tourists Brave a Muddy Jungle Trek to See a Famed World War II Wreck
item.description: Seven Chinese tourists, a dozen villagers and a couple of journalists forded streams and bushwhacked to the downed plane of Isoroku Yamamoto, the Japanese admiral. Machetes proved handy.

item.title: Chiclayo, Pope Leo’s Other Home, Comes Out In Force to Welcome Father Robert
item.description: Leo XIV returned to the city in Peru where he served as bishop for eight years, drawing large crowds who remembered him before he was pope.
